item.description: Quotation: (1) lagais inneir. (2) Nach tu a rinn a’ lagais dhiot fhéin. Notes: dung-heap.
Notes: severe punishment.
[ɫɑ̃:həɣ] Notes: axe.
[ɫɑ̃:vɛdʹ] Notes: handle of cas-chrom.
Notes: grass-hopper.
Notes: ladle.
Notes: phosphorescence in the sea.
[mɑxkɫɑ̃:ɾiʃɡʹ] Notes: monkfish.
Notes: porpoise.
Notes: wrasse.
Quotation: sgeth na mulaichean-màgag (sic). Notes: frog-spawn.
[ru:ɣɑṉ]
Quotation: riabh buntàta. Notes: row of potatoes.
[pɛ̃ṉiɡ] Quotation: pl. [pɛṉiɡʹəṉ]. Notes: small stones used for filling in gaps between larger stones in a dry-stone wall.
Notes: “heel” of cas-chrom.
Notes: a passing shower.
Quotation: sgeth na mulaichean-màgag (sic) [mũ̜ɫiçəṉmɑ̃:ɡɑɡ]. Notes: frog-spawn.
Notes: foot-rest of cas-chrom.
[sɡɾu̟:ɑ̃ṉ] Notes: corn-rick.
[sɡu̟:l] Quotation: sgùil buntàta, sgùil lion mhóir. Notes: basket made from willow wands.
[ʃĩmidʹ] Notes: potato masher, shaped like a baseball bat.
[spɤɣ] Notes: swathe, e.g. of corn.
[ʃtʹɑ:ʴṉɛ̃ṉ] Notes: tern. [NOTES: the turned r used for the symbol which is unclear in the original.]
Notes: dragonfly.
Quotation: an tobhta thogarrach. Notes: removable seat.
Quotation: an tobhta thogarrach. Notes: removable seat in a boat.
[t̪ɤɾɤʃɡʹĩnʹ] Notes: peat-cutting iron.
Quotation: tòrr buntata. Notes: potato pit.
[t̪ud̪ɛ̃ṉ] Notes: makeshift corn-rick. Smaller than a sgrùbhan (q.v.) – made hurriedly because of impending bad weather.
Quotation: banais-chullaich. Notes: a collection of wailing cats at night (Kilmuir).
Quotation: beart mhór. Notes: tackle used for lythe fishing. It consisted of a line with a rubber eel and lead weight towed after the boat.
Notes: iron spike, e.g. for making holes in zinc.
Quotation: Bioran-Ceit[?]-Mhóir. Notes: piece of wood with wool wrapped round the end of it, dipped in oil and used as a torch.
Quotation: pìos blian. Notes: a bit of flank.
Notes: the outside peat.
[bɔtʹɑɡ] Notes: earthworm.
Quotation: breacadh a’ phuill. Notes: lining the peat-bank for skinning.
Notes: a beetle which makes a striking noise. (Dw. Buail a’ chnag – Balm cricket.)
[bu̜ɤɫə] Quotation: buala a’ chruidh. Notes: cow-stall. [NOTES: slipped under ‘buaile’.]
[bu̟:ləsɡ] Notes: can be used for iron hoop on a barrel.
Notes: Great Northern Diver.
Quotation: tòrr buntàta. Notes: potato pit.
Quotation: riabh buntàta. Notes: row of potatoes.
[bu̟:hɔx] Notes: spiked muzzle put on a calf.
Quotation: a’ cabadh a’ bhuntàta. Notes: cleaning potatoes with a hoe.
[kɛvɛṉɑx] Notes: a small brown trout.
Notes: paving stones outside a house.
Notes: byre drain.
[cebə] Notes: cutting part of the cas-chrom.
Notes: tadpole.
[cɑ:ʴd̠iu̜ɫɑ̃ṉ] Notes: a brown insect with a hard body found on dungheaps. Has a “srann”. [NOTES: the turned r used for the symbol which is unclear in the original.]
Notes: meal-chest.
[cu̟ɾɔx] Quotation: Tha ciubhrach uisge ann. Notes: drizzle.
Quotation: Nach tu an claban-muilleadh. Notes: used for a gossip.
Notes: square stern of a boat.
[klwft̪ɤıʃdʹɑx] Notes: half-size creel for taking fish from cairidh. (Would it not be any kind of creel?)
[kṉɑ̃ɡ] Notes: thole-pin.
[kṉɔ̃t̪] Notes: piece of wood put on the gunwhale to save it from the chafing of the oars.
Notes: a round basket with a hole in the top for holding wool for spinning.
[kɤləbĩɤ̃ṉɑṉ] Notes: phosphorescence at sea.
[kɔrəxɑɡılʹtʹ] Notes: coloured glow from embers among ashes.
Notes: slater.
Notes: starfish.
Notes: used for hoeing and lifting potatoes.
Quotation: banais-chullaich. Notes: a collection of cats wailing at night. (Kilmuir)
Notes: lizard.
Notes: crab with a velvety back.
Quotation: Chaneil dìobradh air. Notes: used of incessant rain.
[d̪ɔɾɔv] Notes: fishing tackle. Worked up and down.
[fjɑɫɑɡ] Notes: a chopping-block.
Notes: [ɡʹɔɫə] rather than [ɡʹɔ:ɫə] for a boat.
Quotation: Cha dean mi glanadh dheth. Notes: I can’t make head or tail of it. (From Caol-Rónach.)
[ɡɾɔ̃ɡʹɛ̃ṉ] Notes: hand-grip on a scythe.
Notes: daddy-long-legs.
Notes: V-shaped twigs taken from small trees. Put through roof divots to secure them.
